paragraphs.zh: 将产品环磺酮在不同含水溶液中处理后的氰化物杂质含量对比如下表二：
paragraphs.en: A comparison of the cyanide impurity content of the product tembotrione after treatment in different aqueous solutions is given in Table 2 below:
paragraphs.notes: Taken verbatim from the page's text layer. This sentence announces Table 2, whose printed content is the table image recorded as [0040] and [0041]. It says the variable is the aqueous solution, that is the solvent, not the water content; the table's treatment column does vary the solvent while holding the water at 20% in all four batches, so prose and table agree.

| Test batch | Treatment method | Original cyanide impurity content (ppm) | Cyanide impurity content after treatment (ppm) | Reduction in cyanide impurity content % |

| 7 | After the rearrangement reaction had ended and the solvent had been distilled off, 5g of the product was taken and dissolved in 20% aqueous methanol, the temperature was raised to 60 C, 1g of activated carbon was added and the temperature held for one hour, then hot filtration was carried out; 10% dilute hydrochloric acid was added dropwise under temperature control to adjust the PH to 2, the temperature was gradually lowered to 15 C, and filtration gave purified tembotrione. | 1125 | 32 | 97 |
| 8 | After the rearrangement reaction had ended and the solvent had been distilled off, 5g of the product was taken and dissolved in 20% aqueous ethanol, the temperature was raised to 60 C, 1g of activated carbon was added and the temperature held for one hour, then hot filtration was carried out; 10% dilute hydrochloric acid was added dropwise under temperature control to adjust the PH to 2, the temperature was gradually lowered to 15 C, and filtration gave purified tembotrione. | 1125 | 67 | 91% |
| 9 | After the rearrangement reaction had ended and the solvent had been distilled off, 5g of the product was taken and dissolved in 20% aqueous acetonitrile, the temperature was raised to 60 C, 1g of activated carbon was added and the temperature held for one hour, then hot filtration was carried out; 10% dilute hydrochloric acid was added dropwise under temperature control to adjust the PH to 2, the temperature was gradually lowered to 15 C, and filtration gave purified tembotrione. | 1125 | 81 | 88% |

paragraphs.notes: This paragraph marker has no text of its own in the text layer; its printed content is a table image carrying no text layer at all, and every value below was read from the pixels of the page image at magnification. This is the table announced as Table 2 in the prose at [0039]; no caption line naming Table 2 is printed above the table itself, and no footnote is printed below it. The [0040] region carries the column header row and the data rows for test batches 7, 8 and 9, plus one further row whose only printed content is the first print line of batch 10's treatment cell, the line translating as "After the rearrangement reaction had ended and the solvent had been distilled off", with the batch number and all three numeric cells left blank; the table image then breaks and resumes in the [0041] region, so that last row here is a fragment and is transcribed with its empty cells empty. Print-justification spaces inside the treatment cells, where the print sets the quantities off with a space on either side, are dropped, and line wraps inside a cell are joined with no separator because they are wraps of one sentence. The percent signs are printed half-width. The acid step is printed PH, in capitals, not pH as in the claims; kept as printed. In the reduction column batch 7 prints 97 with no percent sign while batches 8 and 9 print 91% and 88%; kept exactly as printed, see discrepancies. The four treatment cells differ from one another in the solvent alone: methanol, ethanol, acetonitrile and, in [0041], dimethylformamide, each at 20% water. The column header row is printed on this page and was read off it at 6x magnification, so these header cells are the printed header text and not positional placeholders. One character differs from the header of the corresponding table on p05 as reported by the coordinating pass: the first column header here is printed with the character meaning trial, as in trial run, where p05 prints its homophone meaning experiment. Both render in English as test batch, and the cell on this page is kept as printed here.

paragraphs.zh: 将产品环磺酮在不同含水量中处理后的氰化物杂质含量对比如下表三：
paragraphs.en: A comparison of the cyanide impurity content of the product tembotrione after treatment at different water contents is given in Table 3 below:
paragraphs.notes: Taken verbatim from the page's text layer. This is the last line of body text on p07: the table it announces, Table 3, is NOT printed on this page at all, and no part of it appears below this sentence, so it must be looked for on p08. The variable here is the water content, in contrast with [0039] where it is the solvent.

discrepancies.what: The fifth column of Table 2 is the percentage reduction in cyanide impurity content, so it should follow arithmetically from the two ppm columns printed beside it. On three of this page's four batches it does not.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Printed on this page, then the value that follows from the same row's two ppm cells. Batch 7: printed 1125 and 32, printed reduction 97, computed 97.16%, agrees. Batch 8: printed 1125 and 67, printed reduction 91%, computed 94.04%. Batch 9: printed 1125 and 81, printed reduction 88%, computed 92.80%. Batch 10: printed 1125 and 94, printed reduction 81%, computed 91.65%. The computed figures are computed here for this comparison only and appear nowhere on the page; every printed cell in the transcription above is left exactly as printed and none was recomputed, rounded or replaced.
discrepancies.text_says: No prose on this page states any reduction percentage, so nothing in the text either confirms or contradicts the printed column; the disagreement is internal to the patent's results. The coordinating pass reports the same pattern in the other four tables of this patent, which makes it a defect running through the whole results set rather than one bad cell.

discrepancies.what: The reduction column is punctuated inconsistently inside the table image: batch 7's cell prints a bare number with no percent sign while batches 8, 9 and 10 all print one.
discrepancies.drawing_says: 97 for batch 7, against 91%, 88% and 81% for batches 8, 9 and 10.
discrepancies.text_says: The column header itself translates as "Reduction in cyanide impurity content %", so the header carries the percent sign for every row. Cells are kept exactly as printed rather than normalised.
